scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-local-env.mjs && node scripts/generate-app-qr.mjs && npm exec -- vite
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-local-env.mjs && node scripts/generate-app-qr.mjs && npm exec -- vite build
scripts.preview: node scripts/ensure-local-env.mjs && node scripts/generate-app-qr.mjs && npm exec -- vite preview
scripts.env:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path='.env.local.example';const required=['VITE_APP_URL'];const content=fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8');const missing=required.filter((k)=>!content.split(/\r?\n/).some((line)=>line.startsWith(k+'=')));if(missing.length){console.error('Missing required entries in '+path+':', missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('Environment schema check passed')"
scripts.ci:check: npm run env:check && npm run guard:clean && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
